exercises.title: Complete the text with the correct -ed or -ing adjective formed from the verbs in brackets.
content: A LONG WAY HOME

Saroo was born in Madhya Pradesh in India. His family were very poor, so when Saroo was just five, he and his brother Guddu found work on trains as cleaners. One day the boys went to work at a station 70 km from home. The job was very (1)_______ (tire) for Saroo and he fell asleep at the station. He was so (2)_______(exhaust) that he slept for hours. When he woke up, Guddu was not there. Saroo was (3)_______(shock) and (4)_______ (worry). He looked for his brother, but couldn’t find him. It was a very (5)_______ (frighten) situation for a young child.

After two weeks, the police found Saroo, but he could not tell them where his home was- he was too (6)_______ (confuse) and he didn’t know its name. In the end, the police decided he was officially lost and placed him with an adoption agency. An Australian family called Brierley took him to their home in Tasmania and he grew up with them.

As an adult, Saroo Brierley stayed in Australia, but he looked for his home town in India using the photos on Google Earth on his computer. It took months, but Saroo never got (7)_______ (bore) with looking. In the end, he found the town. He was (8)_______ (delight) and travelled there at once. When he saw his mother again for the first time in 25 years, it was a very (9)_______ (move) experience for both of them. Newspapers and TV stations became (10)_______ (interest) in Saroo’s (11)_______(astonish) story and Saroo himself wrote a book about it in 2012.
answers: 1. tiring 		2. exhausted 	3. shocked 		4. worried
5. frightening 	6.  confused		7. bored 		8. delighted
9. moving 		10. interested 	11. astonishing

exercises.title: Complete the sentences with your own words.
content: 1. I feel confused when………………………………………………………
4. I feel excited when…………………………………………………………
5. I feel disappointed when……………………………………………………
answers: Suggested answers:
1. I feel confused when I try to follow instructions that are not clear, especially when there are too many steps to remember.
I also feel confused when people speak too fast in English, because I can’t catch all the words they are saying.
2. I feel bored when I have nothing to do at home, and the day feels like it will never end.
I also feel bored when the lesson is too easy, since I like to be challenged and learn new things.
3. I feel proud when I get a good grade on my exam, because it shows that all my hard work paid off.
I also feel proud when I help my friends with their homework, as it makes me feel useful and confident in my knowledge.
4. I feel excited when I plan a trip with my family, because I love discovering new places and spending time together.
I also feel excited when I try a new activity for the first time, even if I am a little nervous about it.
5. I feel disappointed when my favorite team loses a game, especially if they were playing really well before.
I also feel disappointed when I don’t do well on a test I studied for, because I expected a better result after all my effort.

exercises.title: Speaking Practice.
content: Write short answers to the following prompts. Use at least 2-3 sentences in the past simple tense.
1. What did you do last weekend?
2. Describe a trip you went on.
3. What was the last movie you watched?
4. Did you have fun last summer? What did you do?
5. Talk about a time you helped someone.
answers: Write short answers to the following prompts. Use at least 2-3 sentences in the past simple tense.
Suggested answers:
1. What did you do last weekend?
Last weekend, I went to the park with my friends. We played football and had a picnic. Later, we watched the sunset before heading home.
2. Describe a trip you went on.
I went on a trip to Da Nang last year. I visited the Marble Mountains and walked along the beach. The weather was perfect, and I loved trying the local seafood.
3. What was the last movie you watched?
The last movie I watched was Avatar: The Way of Water. I really enjoyed the special effects and the beautiful underwater scenes. The story was exciting, and it kept me interested until the end.
4. Did you have fun last summer? What did you do?
Yes, I had a lot of fun last summer! I spent most of my time with my cousins at our grandparents’ house. We went swimming in the river, played games, and helped with the garden.
5. Talk about a time you helped someone.
A few months ago, I helped my neighbor fix his bicycle. He couldn’t figure out what was wrong, so I looked at it and fixed the chain. He was very thankful, and it made me feel good to help him.

exercises.title: Rewrite the sentences using Zero conditional.
content: 1. Water boils at 100°C.
2. Plants die without water.
3. Ice melts in the sun.
4. Touching fire causes burns.
5. Metal expands when heated.
6. People get wet in the rain without an umbrella.
7. Sugar dissolves in hot water.
8. Eating too much makes you full.
9. You get tired if you don’t sleep enough.
10. Turning off the light makes the room dark.
answers: 1. If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.
2. If plants don’t get water, they die.
3. If ice is in the sun, it melts.
4. If you touch fire, it burns you.
5. If you heat metal, it expands.
6. If people go out in the rain without an umbrella, they get wet.
7. If you put sugar in hot water, it dissolves.
8. If you eat too much, you feel full.
9. If you don’t sleep enough, you get tired.
10. If you turn off the light, the room becomes dark.
